latest.title: Hands On with AWS Bottlerocket: Evaluating the Security of Amazon's Hardened OS
latest.description: AWS Bottlerocket is well-known as a secure, minimalist operating system, often used to provide a reliable container hosting environment through enhanced security features and reduced attack surface. But how does it actually work when faced with common container escape techniques? Read on to find out!

latest.title: PhishShield AI: Real-Time Cyber Threat Detection System
latest.description: PhishShield AI is a comprehensive full stack cybersecurity product which helps detect any phishing threats along with malicious URLs and SQL injections. Constructed using React and FastAPI, PhishShield AI applies rule-based and pattern recognition algorithms for risk scoring purposes as well as classifying the inputs as being either SAFE, SUSPICIOUS, or PHISHING. Input validations, rate limiting, secure headers, and structured logs add on to the overall security architecture.

latest.title: CDK - Using The Central Register Pattern For Resource Sharing
latest.description: The Central Register Pattern for AWS CDK improves resource sharing by using a central registry to track ARNs and IDs, preventing deployment deadlocks and simplifying CI/CD updates. This approach offers an efficient alternative to traditional resource sharing methods

latest.title: A Novel Pattern for Documenting DynamoDB Access Patterns
latest.description: The article proposes documenting DynamoDB access patterns using a structured JSON format to enhance integration with code and version control. This method facilitates managing complex relationships in single-table designs by prioritizing data access patterns over traditional, static documentation methods.
